thread:
Mira: Quick heads-up — nightly microbench sweep finished for arch-aware picks. Pulling out the weird ones now, but summary: candidate-kernel-13 shows good p50 across A100/AVX2, but large p95 regressions on H100 for seqlen=4096.
Sam: link to artifacts?
Mira: s3://redwood-ci/bench/2065432100/candidate-13.tar.gz — contains raw flamegraphs + harness logs.
Jordan: saw similar in earlier circle: KV cache miss rate spikes with candidate-13 at long seqs? Any traces?
Mira: yes, attached harness log shows KV cache churn. snippet: ```KV_CACHE: capacity=256MB; hits=72%; evictions=18k; avg_kv_latency=0.45ms``` for seqlen=4096. For seqlen<=1024 it's fine.
Ash: interesting — candidate-13 uses a different lane-load ordering to favor contiguous KV slices on AVX2, but on H100 the kernel's memory access pattern causes TLAS thrash under long context.
Sam: perf-bot summary?
perf-bot: nightly-run 2065432100: overall candidate-13 p50 -3% (good), p95 +12% (regression), flakiness_score 0.18 (threshold 0.1), seqlen-bucket regressions flagged: [4096, 8192].
Jordan: 12% p95 is non-starter for hosted. Can we gate this only for H100 and keep it for others?
Ash: yes, the autotuner can be updated to select per-arch kernel variants. Current policy is arch->default kernel, but not seqlen-aware. I propose: add seq_len thresholds so kernel selection becomes (arch, seq_bucket) -> kernel.
Mira: +1. Also note batching heuristics interact: when seq_len>=2048 we currently allow batch_size up to 4; that amplifies cache pressure. Suggest lowering batch cap for long seqs in the policy engine.
Sam: can we simulate the combined effect quickly? e.g., rerun harness with batch_cap=2 for seqlen>=2048 and candidate-13 on H100.
Ash: running now on perf-queue. Command: ```./harness/run_sweep --kernel candidate-13 --arch h100 --seqlens 1024,2048,4096 --batch-caps 2,4 --output s3://redwood-ci/bench/2065432100/rt-rerun/```
perf-bot: rerun queued on perf-runner-12. ETA ~ 22m.
Jordan: if rerun looks clean, we can make a short-term policy tweak: override candidate-13 on h100 for seq>=4096 and keep it for other combos. But long-term fix is kernel memory layout change.
Mira: agreed. Also we should add a regression test to perf CI that checks kv-cache-eviction-rate for long seqs; current tests only check latency and throughput.
Sam: +1. Also add an alert trigger if p95 regression >8% or eviction_rate delta >10% relative to baseline.
Ash: filing a tiny PR to autotuner: seqlen buckets + arch mapping + batch_cap override. Will post link when ready.
Mira: thanks — once PR is up i'll run a quick canary in dedicated for a handful of customers. If canary passes, we ship override while kernel fix lands.
Jordan: note for release notes: mention per-arch+seqlen kernel selection and batch cap mitigation.
Mira: filed internal follow-ups: #ticket-4521 for kernel memory layout, #ticket-4522 for autotune policy change, #ticket-4523 for CI regression test.
Sam: nice triage. @perf-bot keep us posted on rerun. :thumbsup:
